"""Tests for the todo application (store.py and cli.py)."""

import pytest

from cli import main
from store import TodoStore


@pytest.fixture
def store(tmp_path):
    return TodoStore(str(tmp_path / "todos.json"))


def test_add_returns_incrementing_ids(store):
    assert store.add("first") == 1
    assert store.add("second") == 2
    assert store.add("third") == 3


def test_list_hides_done_items(store):
    store.add("open one")
    done_id = store.add("done one")
    store.add("open two")
    store.complete(done_id)

    open_todos = store.list(include_done=False)
    assert [t["text"] for t in open_todos] == ["open one", "open two"]

    all_todos = store.list(include_done=True)
    assert [t["text"] for t in all_todos] == ["open one", "done one", "open two"]


def test_cli_list_hides_done(capsys, store):
    store.add("open one")
    done_id = store.add("done one")
    store.complete(done_id)

    assert main(["list"], store) == 0
    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert out == "#1 open one\n"


def test_cli_list_all_shows_done_with_x_prefix(capsys, store):
    store.add("buy milk")
    store.add("walk dog")
    store.complete(1)

    assert main(["list", "--all"], store) == 0
    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert out == "x #1 buy milk\n#2 walk dog\n"


def test_complete_missing_id_returns_false(store):
    assert store.complete(99) is False


def test_remove_missing_id_returns_false(store):
    assert store.remove(99) is False


def test_ids_not_reused_after_removal(store):
    store.add("one")
    store.add("two")
    store.add("three")
    assert store.remove(2) is True
    new_id = store.add("four")
    assert new_id == 4
    assert [t["id"] for t in store.list()] == [1, 3, 4]


def test_cli_done_and_rm_missing_id(capsys, store):
    assert main(["done", "42"], store) == 1
    err = capsys.readouterr().err
    assert err == "no such todo\n"

    assert main(["rm", "42"], store) == 1
    err = capsys.readouterr().err
    assert err == "no such todo\n"


def test_cli_add_and_done_success(capsys, store):
    assert main(["add", "buy", "milk"], store) == 0
    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert out == "added #1\n"

    assert main(["done", "1"], store) == 0
    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert out == "done #1\n"

    assert main(["rm", "1"], store) == 0
    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert out == "removed #1\n"


def test_cli_unknown_or_missing_subcommand(capsys, store):
    assert main([], store) == 2
    assert capsys.readouterr().err.startswith("usage:")

    assert main(["frobnicate"], store) == 2
    assert capsys.readouterr().err.startswith("usage:")


def test_persistence_across_instances(tmp_path):
    path = str(tmp_path / "todos.json")
    s1 = TodoStore(path)
    s1.add("persisted")
    s1.complete(1)

    s2 = TodoStore(path)
    todos = s2.list(include_done=True)
    assert [t["text"] for t in todos] == ["persisted"]
    assert todos[0]["done"] is True
    assert s2.add("second") == 2

"""Command-line interface for the todo app.

Usage:
    python cli.py add <text...>
    python cli.py list [--all]
    python cli.py done <id>
    python cli.py rm <id>
"""

import sys

USAGE = "usage: cli.py {add <text...> | list [--all] | done <id> | rm <id>}"


def main(argv, store):
    """Run the CLI with the given argv (without the program name) and store.

    Returns the process exit code: 0 on success, 1 for a missing todo id,
    2 for an unknown or missing subcommand.
    """
    if not argv:
        print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    cmd, rest = argv[0], argv[1:]

    if cmd == "add":
        if not rest:
            print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        todo_id = store.add(" ".join(rest))
        print(f"added #{todo_id}")
        return 0

    if cmd == "list":
        if rest and rest[0] == "--all":
            for todo in store.list(include_done=True):
                prefix = "x " if todo["done"] else ""
                print(f"{prefix}#{todo['id']} {todo['text']}")
        elif rest:
            print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        else:
            for todo in store.list(include_done=False):
                print(f"#{todo['id']} {todo['text']}")
        return 0

    if cmd in ("done", "rm"):
        if len(rest) != 1:
            print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        try:
            todo_id = int(rest[0])
        except ValueError:
            print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        if cmd == "done":
            ok = store.complete(todo_id)
            success = f"done #{todo_id}"
        else:
            ok = store.remove(todo_id)
            success = f"removed #{todo_id}"
        if not ok:
            print("no such todo", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(success)
        return 0

    print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
    return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    from store import TodoStore

    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:], TodoStore("todos.json")))

    s2 = TodoStore(path)
    assert s2.add("c") == 3
